meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Bank credit by sector, old classification: agriculture, industry by size, services, personal loans by type, priority sector, monthly April 2007 to December 2020
meta.note: RBI, Deployment of Bank Credit by Major Sectors, old format (DBIE export via the Data Bank), ₹ lakh crore, last reporting Friday of each month. Bank credit, food credit and non-food credit cover all scheduled commercial banks (Section 42 return); every sector and industry row covers the selected banks of the sector-wise and industry-wise return (SIBC), about 90% of non-food credit from September 2017. Priority sector follows the definition before April 2015. A ₹17,300 crore drop in consumer durables in August 2018 corrects one bank's misclassified housing loans. Never joined to the 2019 format.
